name: Restoration Returns Grants
summary: Small grants of US$17,000 from the G20 Global Land Initiative for community-level land restoration projects run by organisations of any size anywhere in the world. The 2025 round has closed and no later round is announced.

eligibility.rule: Activities are at the community level
Has an annual budget over USD 25,000
Is accredited with UNCCD or has applied for accreditation
Project has other funding and does not depend solely on this grant

documents: Maps and photos of project activities
Breakdown of how the grant will be used
Signed letter of request to the UNCCD Executive Secretary

opens.quote: Bonn, 15 July 2025 - The open call for applications for the US$17,000 Restoration Returns Grant opens today.

geography.quote: Projects from all countries in the world are eligible.

access.quote: The call is open to organizations of all sizes for activities at the community level.

amount.quote: The Initiative is increasing the amount allocated to each awardee to US$17,000

eligibility.quote: The call is open to organizations of all sizes for activities at the community level.
Organizations must have an annual budget greater than USD 25,000 to be eligible.
Organization must be accredited with UNCCD. If you are not yet accredited, please apply for UNCCD accreditation before you submit the Grant application.
Stand-alone projects solely depending on this grant will not be considered for support.

documents.quote: Please provide maps and photos of your project’s activities.
Please provide your organization’s official registration documents.
Please provide a detailed table of the projects overall budget.
Please provide a detailed breakdown of how you will use the grant.
Please provide a signed letter with your organization’s letterhead addressed to the Executive Secretary of the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification.
